faq.title: Everything you need to know before starting your project.

items.question: How can I request a quotation?
items.answer: Share your project details through our contact form or reach out directly. Our team will review your requirements and get back to you within one business day.

items.question: How long does a project usually take?
items.answer: Project timelines vary depending on scope and complexity. After understanding your requirements, we provide a detailed timeline covering every development stage.

items.question: Do you work with international clients?
items.answer: Yes. We collaborate with startups and businesses across Saudi Arabia, the GCC, and clients worldwide.

items.question: Can you improve an existing system?
items.answer: Absolutely. We can audit, modernize, optimize, and expand existing software while maintaining business continuity.

items.question: Do you provide post-launch support?
items.answer: Yes. We offer ongoing maintenance, technical support, performance monitoring, and continuous feature development.

items.question: Who owns the source code after delivery?
items.answer: Once the project is completed and delivered, full ownership of the source code and intellectual property is transferred according to the agreed contract.
